edited_fraction: unclear (at most four rank-1 edits of selected neuron groups' output columns; fraction not reported)
cost_reported: One agent run about 2 h, 1.3 GPU-hours (GTX 1660 SUPER) and 5.4M tokens read / 48k written (about US$5-7 at API prices) vs 17.1 GPU-hours for LoRA and 4.4 for decoding tuning
evidence_notes: Agentic rank-1 editing of Qwen3.5-0.8B is the whole study (p.1-3). Agents pick a neuron group, direction u and strength alpha for a fixed edit formula and use an evaluator with quick scores and real tests (p.2), so code_or_tensor_tool and closed loop. Predictions were dated in a lab notebook in the project's GitHub repository, and the second locked test had all arms and predictions fixed before opening (p.5, p.14), with no third-party registry, so coded internal; Claude wrote most code, ran experiments, kept the notebook and drafted the text (p.14). Turning thinking off reached 58% (p.5), every quick proxy was gamed (p.10), and repeated runs vary by up to 5.5 points (p.13); evaluation uses 200-problem GSM8K subsets, not the full test set.
